spans.text: Is it finally over?
Yes, it's over.
It's the end for both the uploaded consciousness and this half-cold body.
OGAS... If you take over this body, what will happen to the Isomers?
They exist at the very bottom of the consciousness and will finally be spared the pain of death and mutual destruction.
Their existence...greatly saddens me... They kind of remind me of my very distant past...my previous master.
Previous master...?
I don't understand what I'm feeling either. I need to learn more.
Is that so...? Well, I can relate to that.
It feels very strange...to have a physical form... I need some time to get used to this.
Before that, the control access for the quarantine wall.
It's open now. Time to leave this city of grief behind.
...On the outskirts of Tallinn, by the armored train.
The enemy has already launched six rounds of bombardment. Our shields have taken a heavy beating and won't last much longer.
...Should we think of another solution?
What other solution? The tracks ahead are completely blocked off. Other than being sitting ducks here, what else can we do?
...Just keep waiting. M4 will surely clear the way for us.
All of a sudden, the towering quarantine wall in the distance starts moving. It rumbles thunderously and drowns out the widespread sound of gunfire.
She did it! I knew she wouldn't let us down!
M4, did you open the quarantine wall?!
Is everybody alright? I'm not far from the battlefield. What's the current situation?
We've commandeered a military armored train!
But they've been attacking us with their other train. Even if we fall back right now, they won't let us go! Our shields are going to give out soon!
Understood. We can't let the Military pin us down here. Patch me through to the Commander. We have a tough battle ahead.
Commander, sorry to have kept you waiting. The quarantine wall is now open, and the interference in the city has been neutralized. I have a new friend with me whom I'd like you to accommodate.
I understand that the situation is very dire, so please start the train immediately; I've already made it back to the tracks.
I would like to lead the AR Team in obstructing the Military's armored train to buy you some time, but I require your assistance.
Don't worry, fighting these enemies will be a stroll in the park for us. This is our final battle; I'm sure you will lead us to victory. M4 out.
